# Sports Data Suits

> > Sports Data Suits develops wearable motion capture technology for sports performance analysis, including Pitcher3D for baseball and Wetsuit 3D for aquatic sports.

The company specializes in inertial-based wearable systems that capture biomechanical data for athletic performance optimization and injury prevention. Their flagship products serve baseball pitchers and swimmers/surfers with real-time motion analysis capabilities.

## Key Topics

- Motion capture technology
- Wearable sensors and inertial systems
- Pitcher3D - baseball pitching analysis
- Wetsuit 3D - aquatic sports tracking
- Sports analytics and performance optimization
- Biomechanical data acquisition
- Tommy John surgery and UCL injury prevention
- MLB pitching injuries
- Swimming and surfing performance data
- American Sports Medicine Institute research
- Real-time athletic performance monitoring
- Sports injury prevention technology
